subject.title: [Feature Request] Code Verification and Signature for Skills

question: What trust model should OpenClaw enforce for SKILL.md skills before they are loaded into prompts or capability decisions?
rationale: This chooses security boundaries, trust roots, revocation behavior, unsigned compatibility, and possible config/profile semantics that an automated cleanup review should not invent.

options.title: Design Canonical Trust Model First
options.body: Define publisher keys, signed digests, revocation, lock/origin binding, status surfaces, and unsigned compatibility before runtime enforcement lands.

options.title: Ship Advisory Audit Status First
options.body: Keep signatures and hashes informational for now, reducing upgrade breakage but not closing the runtime trust boundary.

options.title: Require Verified Skills For Capability
options.body: Degrade or fail closed for unsigned skills, improving security while requiring a migration and override plan for existing installations.

recommendation.title: Design Canonical Trust Model First
recommendation.body: Define publisher keys, signed digests, revocation, lock/origin binding, status surfaces, and unsigned compatibility before runtime enforcement lands.
